answer: Mechanism: proof-of-tenure escrow - joining locks a bond equal to one epoch's median honest fee, logged in a basalt-hard registry. Each signed output carries a unique pigment watermark from the member's key; random audits verify watermarked work exists and predates the vote it weights. A hollow identity lacks such history, fails audit, forfeits. Attacker cost: each puppet locks its own full bond at one flat rate, no bulk discount, so N seats cost N bonds plus forfeitures growing with N; an honest member pays one bond once and reclaims it.
